faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the MPKV Assistant Professor recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application for the MPKV Assistant Professor positions is 01 October 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well in advance to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Assistant Professor post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Ph.D or M.Sc. in Agril. Biotechnology/ Molecular Biology and Biotechnology / Biochemistry subject along with NET conducted by UGC/ICAR/CSIR. Retired Professors from Government Colleges are also eligible.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Assistant Professor post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Assistant Professor (Discipline of Molecular Biology and Biotechnology) post in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for the MPKV Assistant Professor recruitment?
faq.answer: The application fee for General and OBC category candidates is Rs. 500. No application fee is mentioned for other categories in the provided data.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Assistant Professor position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Assistant Professor post will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 45,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for the MPKV Assistant Professor recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the application form and submit it via post or as instructed.

faq.question: Q7. What is the job type for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The posts advertised are temporary contractual positions.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the Mahatma Phule Krishi Vidyapeeth Rahuri located?
faq.answer: Mahatma Phule Krishi Vidyapeeth Rahuri is located in Rahuri, District Ahilyanagar, Maharashtra, with the pincode 413722.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for the Assistant Professor role?
faq.answer: The selection of candidates will be based on an interview conducted by a Selection Committee approved by the University.

faq.question: Q10. Can a retired professor apply for this post?
faq.answer: Yes, retired professors from Government Colleges are also eligible to apply for the Assistant Professor position, provided they meet the other specified qualifications.
